items.exampleEn: Virtually all of our customers pay online now.
items.exampleZh: 現在幾乎所有顧客都在網路上付款。

items.exampleEn: Emma likes to start work early, whereas Jason prefers later hours.
items.exampleZh: Emma 喜歡早點開始工作，而 Jason 偏好晚一點的時段。

items.exampleEn: We will finish the project regardless of the cost.
items.exampleZh: 不管成本多少，我們都會完成這個專案。

items.exampleEn: Tonight's game is Taipei versus Tainan.

items.exampleEn: The manager sent an email concerning the new parking rules.

items.exampleEn: A small cafe stands alongside the old bank.
items.exampleZh: 一家小咖啡店就在老銀行旁邊。

items.exampleEn: In the midst of the meeting, my phone rang.
items.exampleZh: 會議進行到一半，我的手機響了。

items.exampleEn: "Damn, I left my keys in the office!" Kevin said.
items.exampleZh: 「糟了，我把鑰匙忘在辦公室了！」Kevin 說。

items.sentenceEn: Virtually every seat in the hall was taken before the show started.
items.sentenceZh: 演出開始前，大廳裡幾乎每個座位都有人坐了。

items.audioEn: Please send me any questions concerning the new office before Tuesday's meeting.
items.audioZh: 星期二開會前，請把關於新辦公室的任何問題寄給我。
items.questionZh: 說話者要大家在星期二前做什麼？
options: Clean the new office on Tuesday
Send questions about the new office

items.sentenceEn: Damn! The printer is broken again.
In the midst of all the noise, she kept working calmly.
items.sentenceZh: 在一片吵雜聲當中，她依然冷靜地工作。

items.stemEn: Please read the email ____ next week's training.
items.stemZh: 請閱讀關於下週訓練的電子郵件。

items.stemEn: My sister loves big cities, ____ I prefer quiet towns.
items.stemZh: 我的姊妹喜歡大城市，而我比較喜歡安靜的小鎮。

items.passageEn: Daniel had to choose between two job offers, one from a large bank and one from a small design company. It was really a choice of money versus time: the bank offered a higher salary, whereas the design company offered more free time. Virtually all of his friends told him to take the bank job. But in the midst of all this advice, Daniel remembered what he really enjoyed. At the design company, he would work alongside creative people every day. He also had some questions concerning the working hours, so he called the manager, and she answered every question clearly. In the end, Daniel chose the design company, regardless of the lower pay. "Damn, I hope I made the right choice," he said with a laugh on his first day.
items.passageZh: Daniel 必須在兩份工作之間做選擇：一份來自大銀行，一份來自小型設計公司。這其實是金錢對上時間的選擇：銀行給的薪水比較高，而設計公司給的空閒時間比較多。他幾乎所有朋友都叫他去銀行上班。但在這些建議當中，Daniel 想起自己真正喜歡的是什麼。在設計公司，他每天都能和有創意的人一起工作。他對工作時間也有些問題，所以打電話給經理，而她把每個問題都回答得很清楚。最後，Daniel 不顧薪水較低，選擇了設計公司。上班第一天，他笑著說：「糟了，希望我選對了。」

questions.questionZh: Daniel 的朋友大多建議他怎麼做？
Daniel 為什麼打電話給經理？

items.promptZh: 不管天氣如何，比賽都會照常舉行。
referenceEn: The game will take place regardless of the weather.
Regardless of the weather, the game will go ahead as planned.
rubricZh: regardless of 後面可接名詞或 what／whether 子句（例如 regardless of the weather），可放句首或句尾
「照常舉行」可寫 take place、go ahead as planned、be held as usual 等

items.promptZh: 這座城市的北邊很現代，而南邊還有很多老房子。
referenceEn: The north of the city is modern, whereas the south still has many old houses.
The northern part of the city is very modern, whereas the southern part still has lots of old houses.
rubricZh: whereas 連接兩個對比的部分，可放兩部分中間或句首（例如 …, whereas the south… 等）
「北邊」可寫，例如 the north of the city、the northern part 等
「還有很多老房子」可寫，例如 still has many old houses、there are still lots of old buildings 等
